updates.readyToInstall: تم تنزيل Showhow {{latestVersion}}. أعد التشغيل لإكمال التثبيت.
updates.blockedLocation: انقل Showhow إلى مجلد التطبيقات قبل التحديث.

showhowGuide.connectBody: Recording and editing stay on this Mac. Connect OpenRouter when you want a guide.
showhowGuide.ownKey: Use your own OpenRouter API key.
showhowGuide.saveError: Couldn’t save the connection. Try again.
showhowGuide.removeError: Couldn’t remove the key. Try again.
showhowGuide.runError: Couldn’t make the guide. Your recording is safe.
showhowGuide.previewError: Couldn’t prepare the guide. Check the recording folder and try again.
showhowGuide.turnInto: Turn this recording into a guide
showhowGuide.localBody: Showhow transcribes on this Mac. OpenRouter uses the transcript and selected frames to write the guide after you continue.
showhowGuide.keepUsing: You can keep using Showhow while this runs.
showhowGuide.safe: Your recording and deterministic steps are safe.
showhowGuide.narrationOnly: No clicks were captured, so steps follow what you said. Screenshots come from the recording at each transcript timestamp.
showhowGuide.clickOnly: Your guide uses clicks and screenshots. Your recording is saved.
showhowGuide.previousStays: Your current guide stays until the new one is ready.

showhowLibrary.noMatch: No titles match “{{query}}”. Try another search.
showhowLibrary.pickBody: Choose one from the library, or record something new.

importVideo.title: Import video
importVideo.description: Add one local MP4 to your Library. The original file stays unchanged.
importVideo.cancelFailed: Could not cancel yet. Try again, or wait for the import to finish.
importVideo.failedBody: The import could not finish. Check that the file is readable and that there is enough disk space, then try again.
importVideo.body: H.264 video with AAC audio. Click capture is unavailable for imported videos; guides can use narration.

showhowBrief.makeTitle: Make a brief for your agent
showhowBrief.makeBody: Turn this recording into a requested change, observed behaviour and timestamped evidence.
showhowBrief.local: Your recording stays on this Mac. AI is used only when you make the brief.
showhowBrief.keepUsing: You can keep using Showhow while this runs
showhowBrief.safeMaking: Your recording is safe. The brief appears here when it is ready.
showhowBrief.errorChanged: Recording changed. Check what's sent again
showhowBrief.safeFailed: Your recording is safe. Try again or change the AI provider.
showhowBrief.copyNote: Copy includes the brief and the local bundle path. Give your agent access to that folder.
showhowBrief.copyFailed: Couldn't copy. Your brief is saved; try again.
showhowBrief.reviewBody: Sent to OpenRouter only when you continue. The brief is saved in this recording's folder.
showhowBrief.always: Send briefs without asking next time
